verdicts.decision_note: Establishes the task-local floor-plan sketch artifact and its required depiction of dwelling divisions, bathrooms, kitchen cabinets, and separation walls; no delivery deadline is encoded.
First target-specific implementation claim that sketches and analyses were added to the floor plan.
The source changes which interior walls will be demolished or constructed, not the independently defined floor-plan drawing deliverable; it belongs to the wall-planning Requirement.
The encoded room-dimension annotation is independently owned by REQ_PLAN_DIMENSION_ANNOTATIONS, while the other clauses concern bathroom layouts and a separate furnished drawing.
The source changes corridor allocation, an adjacent wall position, and Unit 3 bathroom fixtures rather than the floor-plan artifact's deliverable specification.

missing_event_candidates.description: Client specifies demolition of red-marked interior walls and construction of turquoise-marked walls.
Client explicitly requests room dimensions in the drawing.
Client requests a separate drawing containing furniture and room equipment.
Client requests that the Unit 2 bathroom door be centered and asks for toilet positions to be updated according to existing drains.
Client requests a 10 cm wall shift to narrow the corridor.
Client requests moving the Unit 3 bathroom drain and shower to the left wall.
